description: This file defines classes and functions related to intercepting and handling network requests in WebKit within the Playwright testing framework. It includes request creation, response handling, error management, and request interception logic.

classes.name: WKInterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request in WebKit, capable of creating responses and managing request data.

classes.name: WKRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route handling, including aborting, fulfilling, and continuing requests.

methods.name: adoptRequestFromNewProcess
methods.description: Adopts the request from a new process with a new session and request ID.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a network response object based on the response payload.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the request with a specified error code.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills the request with a specified response.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues the request with optional overrides.
